text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That was quick.
Did you catch the runaway student?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I caught them and gave 'em a thorough lecture.
Sloppy attire leads to sloppy discipline, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
As merciless as ever...
Still, that student was remarkably fleet-footed...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: In short, it could be said to be the fruit of sheer tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There's a knack to chasing down a front runner.
I actually just did some training on that the other day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hoh. So we have our dear Trainer to thank, do we?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool. A Trainer's duty is to instruct.
There is no point in praising what should come naturally.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, we must share the issues identified in this run
and use them to reach even greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even if I were to praise you,
it'd be a problem if you got satisfied with just this level.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Word is, the "Empress" thinks quite highly
of her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's nothing like that. I am merely stating the bare minimum requirements one should expect of a Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that student's shirt is untucked, isn't it?
Don't you need to crack down on that?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Agh, we're having a serious talk about this later!
You just wait right there!
